newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower as yen rise hurts exporters.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower as yen rise hurts exporters.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed moderately lower on Thursday as the yen's rapid advance against the dollar clouded prospects for export-driven issues, brokers said.

The weak sentiment was further hurt by the news that Tokyo prosecutors had raided Nomura Securities Co Ltd's headquarters as part of an investigation into suspected illegal payoffs, raising concerns about other brokerages, they said.
The 225-share Nikkei average gave up 153.41 points or 0.76 percent to close at 20,056.31, off an earlier low of 19,854.99. Its June futures fell 180 points to 20,060.
